SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
THURSDAY - SEPTEMBER 25, 2025 - 07:00 P.M.
CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at cerritos.gov and at the Office of the City Clerk, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 1st floor, Cerritos, CA, during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the legislative body after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection in the Office of the City Clerk during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to city_clerk@cerritos.gov or by phone at (562) 916-1248 during regular business hours.
Order of Agenda
The City Council, by majority of those members present, may reorder the business items listed on the agenda.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at cerritos.gov, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in person in the Council Chamber.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in person at the meeting or in writing as described below.
In-person public comment : Public comment on business agenda items will be opened and may be provided during consideration of that business agenda item. Public comment on Consent Calendar, Closed Session, and non-agenda items will be opened and may be provided during Agenda Item No. 6.
Written public comment (hard copy or email) : Public comment may be submitted via email to city_clerk@cerritos.gov or by hard copy to the Office the City Clerk at 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703 no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the legislative body prior to the meeting and retained with the official meeting record.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 916-1248 or at city_clerk@cerritos.gov in advance of the meeting to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.
With the exception of Item 9A, all agenda items will be held concurrently with the Thursday, September 25, 2025, 7:00 p.m. City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting agenda.

This section is reserved for public comment on Consent Calendar, Closed Session, and items not listed on the agenda but that are within the subject matter jurisdiction of the legislative body. Verbal comments will be limited to three minutes per speaker, subject to the Mayor/Chair extending to a maximum of five minutes per speaker, with a total time allotted not to exceed 45 minutes unless the Mayor/Chair extends.
7.
Consent Calendar
Items listed under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one motion. Subject to the discretion of the legislative body, there will be no separate discussion of these items unless a legislative body member or citizen so requests, in which event the item may be removed from the Consent Calendar and considered separately.

MINUTES OF A SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL HELD THURSDAY,
SEPTEMBER 25, 2025, 7:00 PM, IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBER AT CERRITOS CITY HALL,
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA.

With the exception of Item 9A, all agenda items were held concurrently with the Thursday,
September 25, 2025, 7:00 p.m. City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting agenda.
Details for the Regular Meeting Agenda items are provided in the Thursday, September 25,
2025, 7:00 p.m. City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes.

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Pastor Dustin Parker, Concordia Lutheran Church.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Troop 394.

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council were in attendance:

  Councilmember Jennifer Hong
  Councilmember Mark E. Pulido
  Councilmember Sophia M. Tse
  Mayor Pro Tem Lynda P. Johnson
  Mayor Frank Aurelio Yokoyama

5.  Presentations/Appointments

  None.

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions

As referenced above, with the exception of Item 9A, all agenda items, including Item 6, Public
Comments and Suggestions, were held concurrently with the Thursday, September 25, 2025,
7:00 p.m. City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting agenda.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period for items not listed on the meeting
  agenda but that were within the subject matter jurisdiction of the City Council, the
  Consent Calendar, and Closed Session.

  Benjamin Ao expressed concern regarding the verbiage included in the Oath of Office
  administered to elected and appointed officials in the City of Cerritos, requesting the
  City include verbiage required by Federal law, for public officials.

  Teddy Lloyd offered suggestions for revenue generation and economic development,
  including pickleball events and partnerships with local universities.

  City Attorney, Pam Lee, noted the distinction between required language for oaths of
  office administered to Federal public officials under United States Code (5 U.S.C. §
  3331) and State of California (CA Constitution, Article XX, Section 3) oath of office
  language requirements, for State and local public officials.
 City of Cerritos  Thursday, September 25, 2025, 7:00 p.m.

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions (continued)

  David Pylman expressed concern regarding modification to the City Council meeting
  regular schedule and requested Agenda Item 7C be pulled from the Consent Calendar
  for separate consideration.

  The Mayor announced that prior to the meeting, the Councilmembers received full-
  text, unredacted copies of five (5) written comments submitted for Item 6 (inclusive
  of one (1) comment for Item 5A listed on the Thursday, September 25, 2025 City
  Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Agenda), by the deadline listed on the
  agenda and for inclusion in the official record. Requests for copies of the written
  comments submitted for this meeting can be made during regular business hours to
  the Office of the City Clerk.

  Seeing no further speakers, the Mayor declared the public comments period closed.

7.  Consent Calendar

  None.

8.  Public Hearings

  None.

9.  New and Old Business

9A.  Review and consideration of updated information for options related to Measure A
  funding compliance requirements (COUNCIL).

  This item was considered immediately following New and Old Business Item 9A listed
  on the Thursday, September 25, 2025, 7:00 p.m. City Council/Successor Agency
  Regular Meeting agenda, pursuant to City Council consensus direction.

  A staff report was given by Annie Hylton, Director of Community and Cultural Services.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period.

  Catherine Pascual spoke in favor of amending the City’s reservation and class policies
  to comply with Measure A requirements and requested improvements to existing park
  equipment.

  David Pylman expressed concern regarding the amount of public participation during
  consideration of this agenda item and requested the matter be continued to allow
  additional opportunity for community input.

  Seeing no further speakers, the Mayor declared the public comments period closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Johnson, and seconded by Pulido to direct staff to change
  the City’s reservation (City Facility Use and Rental Policy, Policy No. 7.08) and class
  policies at Cerritos Park East and Liberty Park II, effective October 15, 2025, to comply
  with Measure A requirements (COUNCIL).

9.  New and Old Business

9A.  (continued)

  The motion carried (3 – 2) as follows:

  AYES:  Pulido, Johnson, Yokoyama
  NOES:  Hong, Tse
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

10.  Legislative Items

  None.

11.  Reports

  None.

12.  Closed Session

  None.

13.  Adjournment

  The meeting adjourned at 12:30 a.m. on Friday, September 26, 2025.
